text:
An AI attending teaches while you work, using the actual numbers in front of you.

Not a textbook paragraph. Not a generic explanation of what pulmonary edema is. It reads this patient's vitals, this patient's results, what you have already ordered, and it teaches from there.

Why is she still hypotensive after fluids? It looks at the pressure that will not budge and walks you to the answer. The vessels are open. She needs tone, not more volume.

It remembers what you asked five minutes ago. It teaches the case in front of you, not a generic one.

Caleb never taught me from a manual. He taught me from the problem we were both looking at. That is the difference. The teaching that sticks is always attached to something real.
